page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps, which supports standard data transfer needs. The hardware profile represents a balanced resource density, offering a stable and predictable performance environment for workloads that do not require specialized hardware acceleration or high-speed local NVMe drives.

The ecs.g6t.4xlarge is suitable for general-purpose workloads such as medium-sized databases, application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, and enterprise applications. Its balanced CPU-to-memory ratio ensures efficient resource utilization for multi-threaded applications that require consistent compute and memory performance without the overhead of specialized compute or memory-optimized configurations.
